## Line graph solution

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#Produce the plot with vectors created inside the function
plot(x = rep(1:10, 2), 
     y = seq(from = 0.5, to = 10, by = 0.5),
     col = "red",
     main = 'A line graph with "red" as the colour',
     type = "l")
```
